question: On 21 May 2021, Hockey India was honoured with which prestigious award by the International Hockey Federation (FIH)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Etienne Glichitch Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Etienne Glichitch Award, 2021**

 
 
• On **May 21 (Friday), 2021**, Hockey India received the esteemed **Etienne Glichitch Award** in honour of its contribution to the expansion and improvement of the sport in the nation.
 
• During the **HockeyInvites virtual conference**, the awards were presented by the **International Hockey Federation (FIH)**, the organisation that oversees the sport. 
 
• It was a component of the **47th FIH Congress**, which ended with the FIH Honorary Awards.
 
• According to a Friday press release from the FIH, **"Hockey India was announced as the recipients of the Etienne Glichitch Award in appreciation of its exceptional commitment to the growth and development of Hockey."**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The honour carries **Etienne Glichitch's name, who served as the FIH's Hon. Secretary from 1966 until 1984**, when he was elected its President, a position he held until **1996**. 
 
• His** innovative methods and great dedication** to the sport helped to lay the foundation for the FIH as it is recognised today.
 
• **Gyanendro Ningombam**, the president of Hockey India, thanked the FIH for recognising **Hockey India's efforts to develop the sport in India**.
